title: DC's Legends of Tomorrow
description: 50 questions about the TV series DC's Legends of Tomorrow, from season 1 to season 7. Each game asks you 10.

questions.text: Legends of Tomorrow is a spin-off of which two TV shows?
questions.explanation: The show started in January 2016.

questions.text: Which TV network showed Legends of Tomorrow?
questions.explanation: It ran from 2016 to 2022.

questions.text: How many seasons did Legends of Tomorrow have?
questions.explanation: The CW ended the show in April 2022.

questions.text: What is the name of the Legends' time-travelling ship?
questions.explanation: The Waverider belonged to Rip Hunter at first.

questions.text: What is the name of the Waverider's artificial intelligence?
questions.explanation: Gideon helps the Legends from the very first season.

questions.text: Who brings the first team of Legends together in season 1?
questions.explanation: Rip recruits a mix of heroes and villains from 2016.

questions.text: Which actor plays Rip Hunter?
questions.explanation: Rip Hunter leads the team in season 1.

questions.text: What is Ray Palmer's superhero name?
questions.explanation: Ray Palmer is the Atom.

questions.text: What is Sara Lance's hero name?
questions.explanation: Sara Lance is White Canary. Later she becomes the captain of the Waverider.

questions.text: What is Mick Rory's nickname?
questions.explanation: Mick Rory is Heat Wave.

questions.text: What is Leonard Snart's nickname?
questions.explanation: Leonard Snart is Captain Cold.

questions.text: Firestorm is made when which two people merge?
questions.explanation: Martin Stein and Jefferson 'Jax' Jackson share the powers of Firestorm.

questions.text: Which Legend is Hawkgirl?
questions.explanation: Kendra and Hawkman (Carter Hall) leave the team after Vandal Savage is defeated.

questions.text: What is Nate Heywood's hero name?
questions.explanation: Nate is a historian when he first appears.

questions.text: Which actress plays Sara Lance?
questions.explanation: Caity Lotz is in the main cast of the show.

questions.text: Which actor plays Ray Palmer?
questions.explanation: Brandon Routh is in the main cast of the show.

questions.text: Which actor plays Mick Rory?
questions.explanation: Dominic Purcell is in the main cast of the show.

questions.text: Which actor plays Leonard Snart?
questions.explanation: Wentworth Miller also plays Leo Snart, a double from another Earth, in season 3.

questions.text: Which actor plays Martin Stein?
questions.explanation: Victor Garber plays one half of Firestorm.

questions.text: Which actress plays Zari?
questions.explanation: Zari joins the team in season 3.

questions.text: John Barrowman, who plays Captain Jack in Doctor Who, plays which villain in season 2?
questions.explanation: Malcolm Merlyn is one of the villains who team up against the Legends.

questions.text: Who is the immortal villain the Legends chase in season 1?
questions.explanation: In the future, Savage has conquered the Earth, and Rip wants to stop him.

questions.text: In season 1, Rip Hunter is a member of which group?
questions.explanation: The Time Masters are also part of the trouble the Legends face in season 1.

questions.text: Which time-travelling bounty hunter attacks the Waverider in season 1?
questions.explanation: Chronos is a bounty hunter who travels through time.

questions.text: In the pilot, the Legends first travel to which year?
questions.explanation: They go there to meet an expert who knows a lot about Vandal Savage.

questions.text: At the end of season 1, which Legend sacrifices himself to save the team?
questions.explanation: Captain Cold's sacrifice is one of the big moments of season 1.

questions.text: What is the team of villains in season 2 called?
questions.explanation: It includes Eobard Thawne, Damien Darhk and Malcolm Merlyn.

questions.text: In season 2, which of these villains is part of the team against the Legends?
questions.explanation: Matt Letscher plays Eobard Thawne.

questions.text: In season 2, the villains hunt for the Spear of Destiny. What is special about it?
questions.explanation: With the Spear, the villains rewrite reality.

questions.text: Which hero from Arrow does Nate Heywood ask for help to find the scattered Legends?
questions.explanation: Oliver Queen is played by Stephen Amell.

questions.text: In 'The Justice Society of America', the Legends meet the JSA in which occupied city?
questions.explanation: The Legends land in Nazi-occupied Paris.

questions.text: In season 3, who creates the Time Bureau to replace the Time Masters?
questions.explanation: At first, the Legends are told to stop travelling through time.

questions.text: What kind of villain is Mallus?
questions.explanation: Mallus is the main villain of season 3.

questions.text: In 'Aruba-Con', which Roman ruler turns up in Aruba?
questions.explanation: Sara, Nate and Ray try to take him back to his own time.

questions.text: In 'Freakshow', the Legends visit a circus in 1870 Wisconsin. Which extinct animal do they find there?
questions.explanation: It is an anachronism: something that does not belong in that time.

questions.text: What is the name of the Time Bureau agent who chases Zari in 2042?
questions.explanation: Agent Gary Green first meets Zari in season 3.

questions.text: In 'Beebo the God of War', a young Martin Stein gets a toy that sends him back in time. What is it called?
questions.explanation: Beebo comes back in the season 3 finale, 'The Good, the Bad & the Cuddly'.

questions.text: In the season 3 finale, Mallus demands that the Legends hand over what?
questions.explanation: Mallus is the demon from season 3.

questions.text: In which city does Zari live in 2042?
questions.explanation: Zari is a hacktivist.

questions.text: After the Legends defeat Mallus, where do they go on vacation?
questions.explanation: The vacation does not last long.

questions.text: Which magic expert interrupts their vacation to tell them they have released magical creatures?
questions.explanation: The Legends must now recapture the magical fugitives.

questions.text: In 'Witch Hunt', the Legends visit which famous witch trials?
questions.explanation: A magical creature is causing trouble in the town.

questions.text: In the season 4 premiere, a magical threat leads the team to which famous music festival?
questions.explanation: John Constantine tells Sara about the threat.

questions.text: Who becomes the captain of the Waverider after Rip Hunter?
questions.explanation: Sara is promoted after Rip's sacrifice in the fight against Mallus.

questions.text: In 'A Head of Her Time', the Legends meet which famous French queen in 1793?
questions.explanation: She has a magic perfume.

questions.text: Who takes Sara Lance away at the end of season 5?
questions.explanation: The Legends spend season 6 chasing aliens through history.

questions.text: Which famous musician tells Ava Sharpe in 1977 London that Sara was about to propose?
questions.explanation: Ava learns it in the season 6 premiere, 'Ground Control to Sara Lance'.

questions.text: What special ability does Esperanza 'Spooner' Cruz have?
questions.explanation: Spooner joins the Legends in season 6.

questions.text: At the start of season 7, the Legends are stuck in which year?
questions.explanation: They are stranded in Odessa, Texas.

questions.text: In season 7, the Waverider's AI goes rogue. What does she send after the Legends?
questions.explanation: The Legends have to beat their own robot copies.
